title: Nell and the Log
note: b414 — Phase 3, consonants x, y, z added.

pages.brief: Close view of Nell the bee resting on a grey log, showing her small body clearly.
Nell the bee humming with wings blurred, perched on the grey log.
Several different small bugs sitting together on and around the old grey log.
Nell the bee at the entrance of a round gap in the side of the grey log.
Close view of the round gap in the log, just big enough to enter.
Nell the bee resting inside the dim den inside the log.
Nell the bee humming softly while resting inside the den.
Several small bugs napping together inside and around the old grey log.
